messages:
elaine_pm: Quick preflight — rolling out model-router v1.8 to prod tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Need rollback-readiness signoff. Owner: @ryan_release, SRE oncall: @maria_sre. Can everyone confirm runbook + smoke checks?
ryan_release: I'm deploy owner. Plan: 09:45 promote canary (10% traffic), 10:00 ramp to 100% over 30m if no alarms. I'll run smoke + perf checks at canary and remain on-call for the window.
maria_sre: I'm oncall. Confirmed runbook steps, rollback hot-path ready. Watchlist: p95 latency on /generate, error spike >1% in 5m. I'll set temporary alerts and a dashboard.
qa_jen: QA smoke plan: basic chat flow, embeddings sanity, token count regression. I'll run smoke at canary and post a quick pass/fail in this thread.
sam_platform: Two infra items: autoscaler locked during rollout; snapshot of model config saved to s3: s3://redwood-deploys/model-router/v1.8/snapshot-1782123456.json. Pre-warmed instances staged.
devops_bot: Deployment scheduled by ryan_release at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z — canary: 10%, ramp: manual.
ryan_release: Rollback criteria (short):
  1) 5m error rate increase >= 1% absolute over baseline
  2) sustained 5m p95 latency > 2000ms
  3) QA-detected regression in hallucination/quality for core prompt set
If any hit, immediate rollback to v1.7 and notify #incidents + stakeholders.
elaine_pm: Who executes rollback and who verifies? @ryan_release executes, @maria_sre verifies infra and health, @sam_platform toggles routing if needed.
maria_sre: Minimal runbook excerpt:
```
# rollback runbook excerpt
- stop routing to v1.8 (routing-service -> set weight 0)
- promote v1.7 canary to 100%
- invalidate caches: POST /admin/invalidate?model=model-router
- verify: p95 < 800ms, errors <0.3% for 10m
- notify: #eng-releases, #customers using canned template
```
qa_jen: I'll prep the customer notification template: "We rolled back to v1.7 due to elevated error rates; investigating; ETA 30m." I'll paste it here before deploy.
ryan_release: Pre-staging commands ready: `deployctl promote --model model-router --version v1.7 --to prod` and `deployctl snapshot --save s3://redwood-deploys/rollback-prep/1782123456`
sam_platform: I'll watch DB connection pools + LB draining. Pre-allocated extra headroom in the pool. If rollback happens, I'll coordinate the drain and any network toggles.
elaine_pm: Go/no-go checklist before canary: all participants present online? ryan_release, maria_sre, qa_jen, sam_platform, devops_bot respond with :thumbsup:
ryan_release: :thumbsup:
maria_sre: :thumbsup:
qa_jen: :thumbsup:
sam_platform: :thumbsup:
devops_bot: :thumbsup:
elaine_pm: Great. Final notes: snapshot of prod config saved, rollback commands ready, alerts set. If rollback occurs, take a postmortem with 48h timeline and log all timings. I'll update the runbook doc with the thresholds and the exact alert IDs. Thanks — I'll ping 30m before deploy.
ryan_release: Noted. I'll post canary health links to #eng-telemetry and link them here once canary starts.
qa_jen: I'll be standing by to run smoke and will post pass/fail within first 10 minutes of canary.
maria_sre: I'll keep an eye on alerting and be ready to execute validation steps after rollback.
elaine_pm: Thanks team — this thread will be the single source during rollout, please avoid fragmentation.
summary: Preflight for model-router v1.8 rollout: owners, schedule, rollback criteria, runbook excerpt, go/no-go ack
